title: Desktop first-run follow-ups: a refused sign-in says why, Cancel ends the round on the server, the connected AI account is the pick and never gets a not-installed card
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1176-onboard-v2-followups.mjs
S2: Read one ok/not ok line per fence.
expect: Refused exchange shows the reason: GET /login?onboard=1&reason=not-admitted draws the whitelist alert; expired/denied/failed draw 'The sign-in did not finish. Try again.'; an unknown reason draws nothing and is not echoed; the app maps a 403 SIGN_IN_REFUSED/NOT_ADMITTED redeem to /login?reason=not-admitted and keeps onboard=1 on a first run.

Cancel flips the round: POST /auth/link/:nonce/cancel with the round's clientSecret answers 204, the poll reads denied, a later /signin/approve answers 400 and the session redeem 404; wrong secret, lane round and approved round are untouched; the app sends the cancel once with the secret only in the body.
The not-installed card is absent when the picked vendor is connected.
A connected account is preselected over the scan's pick (the one in status.next first), sits in the main grid, and the panel shows data-connect=connected with no [data-warn].
fence: SIGN_IN_REASONS in identity/pages.js; cancelDesktopLink in identity/store.js; signInFailedUrl and the abort hook in the desktop handoff; accountView/connected action in tracy-onboard flow.ts
